title: The Chief of the Kus Police and the Sharper
logline: A smooth stranger sells the chief of police a chest of "robber's treasure" for a thousand honest dinars; by morning the gold is brass, the gems are glass and the stranger is gone.
moral: The trickster did not sell treasure; he bought, cheaply, the trust of a man who believed he knew all about thieves. Pride and greed make even the expert easy to fool.
tone: Dry comedy of a con: warm lamp-lit flattery, a dazzling reveal, then a cold bright morning. The audience is let in on the trick by small mask-off moments; the chief never is, until the end. Ends in rueful shame, not cruelty.

beats.summary: The chief of police, proud of his badge, at home under his own WANTED poster.
A finely dressed stranger arrives; his servant staggers under a heavy chest.
He asks for a secret meeting; the chief is flattered.
Confession: he was a highway robber (thought-cloud flashback).
He kneels and repents; the chief softens. First mask-off wink.
The chest is worth forty thousand dinars (counter).
The lid opens on a blaze of rings and stones; the chief gets coin eyes.
The offer: everything for only one thousand lawful dinars.
The chief does the sum: piety and profit at once.
He pays despite the treasurer's doubt and hugs the chest.
Outside, the pair drop the act and vanish into the night.
The chief nearly tests a ring, shrugs, and sleeps on the chest till morning.
The goldsmith: brass, tin and glass. The glow dies.
Rage; guards sent out; no trace.
He bought the chief's trust for a cheap story.
The expert on thieves, under his own WANTED poster, lowers his head.

actions.acting: smug: chin up, lid 0.4

actions.action: beckons toward the door with two fingers
actions.acting: impatient bounce on his heels

actions.action: door opens; a small old goldsmith walks in with a loupe on a cord and a leather apron; label MASTER GOLDSMITH
actions.acting: stooped, calm, squint; unhurried steps
actions.library: person {costume:'carpenter', pal grey apron, age:0.85} + walk()/footfalls; S.label

actions.action: presents the chest with a showman flourish and flips the lid open; glow
actions.acting: big grin, armsOut, overshoot

actions.action: rubs finger and thumb: how much? a small ? tag with a coin
actions.acting: eyebrows bounce twice

actions.action: kneels at the chest; raises the loupe to one eye; is not dazzled at all
actions.acting: one eye shut (wink L), the other huge behind the lens; no smile
actions.library: kneel:1; wink:'L'; loupe prop magnifies the open eye 1.6x

scenes.summary: The goldsmith tests the pieces one by one, then tells him: not gold, not silver, but brass, tin and stones of glass.

camera.notes: Chest and hands {x:480,y:770,zoom:2.1}, chief face kept in the upper right corner; three short holds, no camera move, so the falling glow does the work.

scenes.composition: Goldsmith hands at left, chest centre, chief face upper right. Each tested piece is laid in a row on the floor in front of the chest (x 380, 440, 500) and gets its label. The glow drops by a third with each verdict.

actions.action: lifts the big ring to the loupe and turns it
actions.acting: steady hands, eye huge in the lens, slow blink

actions.action: scratches the ring on a small black touchstone: the yellow rubs off grey; lays it down
actions.acting: tiny frown
actions.library: kfn scratch stroke; mixHex gold to grey on the ring (fake 0..1)

actions.action: flicks a bowl with his nail (TINK lettering), bends it with two fingers; lays it down
actions.acting: eyebrow up

actions.action: holds the red stone to the window light, sighs, lowers the loupe
actions.acting: long blink, head shake

actions.action: leans in grinning, hands rubbing, waiting for a number
actions.acting: coin eyes, brow -0.4, tip 0.1

actions.action: slow shake of the head, flat hand cuts the air
actions.acting: eyes shut, mouth frown

actions.action: tag GOLD pops over the heap with a red X; glow drops to 0.66
actions.acting: X stamps in 2 frames

actions.action: tag SILVER with a red X; glow to 0.4; chief coin eyes blink back to pupils
actions.acting: chief smile freezes, one brow twitches

actions.action: label BRASS lands on the scratched ring; the ring turns dull orange
actions.acting: label thuds down with squash

actions.action: label TIN lands on the bent bowl; it turns flat grey
actions.acting: chief mouth to o

actions.action: drops the red stone on the floor: it cracks in two like a bottle chip
actions.acting: does not even watch it fall
actions.library: fallY; two shard polygons; CLINK lettering

actions.action: label GLASS on the shards; glow dies completely, the whole heap goes dull; chief face loses its yellow light
actions.acting: chief: eyes wide, sq 0.94 sag, turban slips forward

scenes.summary: The chief explodes with rage.

camera.notes: Chief {x:640,y:660,zoom:1.9}; panel-only shake 4 px on the stamp at 157.0; then ease out to {x:480,y:690,zoom:1.3} as the guards run in.

scenes.composition: Chief centre right, red face; goldsmith small at lower left packing his loupe; door at left where two guards appear.

actions.action: trembles; red dots climb his face from the collar to the turban; two steam puffs
actions.acting: brow 1, grit mouth, tremble 3 growing, held breath

actions.action: stamps and flings both fists up; turban jumps off his head and lands back crooked
actions.acting: anticipation crouch 0.3 s before, then stretch sq 1.1
actions.library: anticipate; aL/aR raised angles; hop for the turban; panel-only shake

actions.action: kicks the chest: junk rings bounce out and roll; he hops holding his toe
actions.acting: pain: one eye shut, hop on one foot
actions.library: hop + landSquash; painPulse at the toe; rings roll (kfn)

actions.action: slips his loupe into his apron, bows and edges out past the two guards who rush in
actions.acting: tactful, eyes down; guards wide eyed, not in unison
actions.library: walk(); guards person {costume:'guard'} enter with stagger(i)

scenes.summary: He sends his men to search for the visitor. They look everywhere and find no trace.

camera.notes: Street strip w 2400: pan camX 0 to 1100 (159.6-164.2) across the search, stop on the two guards meeting in the empty street.

scenes.composition: Bright day market street. Guard A (red tunic) searches low, guard B (blue tunic) searches high; they meet at centre x about 1500 with open hands. Nothing of the sharper anywhere.

actions.action: in the doorway at far left the chief arm points down the street
actions.acting: only the arm and a shaking fist: rage at a distance
actions.library: marketStreet door anchor; aR angle point

actions.action: two guards run out, split left and right of the street
actions.acting: A leans forward eager, B half a second late

actions.action: guard A lifts a barrel lid and looks in; guard B looks under a stall awning
actions.acting: saccade eyes, hand shading brow
actions.library: townProp 'barrel'; marketStall; PERSON_HANDS.shield over the eyes

actions.action: small thought tag between them: the sharper turban as an outline with ?
actions.acting: pops then fades

actions.action: A checks behind a crate, B looks down the alley: nothing; a dust curl blows through
actions.acting: shoulders drop step by step

actions.action: they meet in the middle, shrug with open palms, look at camera
actions.acting: the one lens stare of the film; brows up

scenes.summary: The chief understands: the trickster did not sell a chest of treasure; he bought, cheaply, the trust of a man who thought himself an expert on thieves. THE END.

camera.notes: Chief and chest {x:580,y:720,zoom:1.6}; pull out 170.5-176.0 to {x:520,y:620,zoom:1.1} so the poster, the cloud and the small figure under them compose the last picture. Hold from 176.8.

scenes.composition: Chief sits on the floor against the open chest of dull junk at 520, facing camera. Cloud 440 x 280 at world (330, 330). WANTED poster at (700, 470) directly above his head. End title in the upper third of the panel, clear of his face.

actions.action: slumped on the floor by the chest, a brass ring in his fingers; his head comes up slowly
actions.acting: lid 0.6 to 0.1, brow -0.6, realisation

actions.action: thought cloud: the sharper and servant far away on a dusk desert road, walking off, the sharper tossing the purse
actions.acting: cloud figures cheerful, never look back
actions.library: thoughtCloud 440x280; desertRoad inside; walk(); purse arc

actions.action: looks down at the chest; lets the ring drop into it (dull clack, no sparkle)
actions.acting: eyes follow the ring; mouth frown

actions.action: in the cloud a tag pops over the purse: 1,000; an arrow from it to a small heart with the chief badge on it
actions.acting: arrow draws on; heart-badge pops
actions.library: S.arrow, S.label; heart() from Library props + badge disc

actions.action: his hand goes to his own badge; he unpins it and looks at it
actions.acting: wet eyes, long blink

actions.action: cloud pops; he looks up at the WANTED poster over his head
actions.acting: gaze straight up, brow -0.8

actions.action: the poster corner peels and it slides down the wall to land across his lap: the masked face looks out next to his
actions.acting: chief flinches (sq 0.95), then stares at camera for 8 frames
actions.library: fallY + swing for the poster; gaze [0,0.05]

actions.action: shame ending: eyes break away from the lens, head drops, turban slides over his eyes
actions.acting: lid 0.8, head drop 10 px, shoulders sag sq 0.95

actions.action: chest lid falls shut by itself (2-frame squash); THE END title holds over the still picture; he breathes
actions.acting: only breathing and one blink under the turban edge
actions.library: S.title THE END; breathe; chest lid 1 to 0 with impactSquash

ending.description: After the last word (177.68) the chief sits on the floor by the dull chest with the fallen WANTED poster across his lap, turban over his eyes. The lid drops shut at 178.05 (thud in the silence) and THE END (Bangers, upper third of the panel) holds to 181.46 while he only breathes and blinks once.

subtitles.ar: كان علاء الدين رئيس الشرطة في مدينة قوص،|يجلس في بيته ذات مساء حين جاءه رجل حسن الثياب والهيئة.|وقف خلفه خادم يحمل صندوقًا ثقيلًا،|وطلب الزائر مقابلة الرئيس في أمر سري.
subtitles.en: Ala al-Din, chief of police in Kus,|was at home one evening when a well-dressed stranger arrived|with a servant carrying a heavy chest|and requested a private meeting.

subtitles.ar: رحب رئيس الشرطة بالرجل، وأجلسه إلى جانبه، وسأله عن حاجته.|قال الضيف إنه كان يقطع الطريق ويسرق أموال الناس،|لكنه يريد أن يترك تلك الحياة ويتوب، ويبدأ عملًا شريفًا.
subtitles.en: The chief welcomed him.|The stranger confessed that he had robbed travelers|but claimed he now wished to repent and earn an honest living.

subtitles.ar: أشار الرجل إلى الصندوق،|وقال إن فيه حليًا وجواهر ومعادن ثمينة تساوي أربعين ألف دينار.|فتح الغطاء، فظهرت أشياء لامعة،|وخواتم كبيرة، وأحجار براقة، فتعجب رئيس الشرطة من كثرتها.
subtitles.en: Pointing to the chest,|he claimed it held jewels and precious metal worth forty thousand dinars.|He opened it to reveal gleaming ornaments,|rings and sparkling stones.

subtitles.ar: قال الزائر إنه لا يريد الاحتفاظ بهذه الأشياء التي حصل عليها في حياته الماضية.|وعرض أن يسلم الصندوق كله للرئيس مقابل ألف دينار من مال حلال،|يبدأ بها تجارة جديدة تعينه على الاستقامة.
subtitles.en: He said he wanted none of the goods from his former life.|He offered the whole chest for a thousand honestly earned dinars|to start a lawful trade.

subtitles.ar: أعجب رئيس الشرطة بما ظنه توبة صادقة،|وسر أيضًا بما بدا له من ربح كبير.|نادى خازنه وأمره بإحضار ألف دينار،|فدفعها إلى الرجل، وتسلم منه الصندوق في الحال.
subtitles.en: Pleased by the apparent repentance|and the apparent bargain,|the chief ordered his treasurer to bring a thousand dinars.|He paid the stranger and accepted the chest.

subtitles.ar: شكر الرجل رئيس الشرطة، ووعده أن يذكر فضله،|ثم خرج مع خادمه في الليل.|بقي الصندوق عند الرئيس، الذي لم يفحص ما فيه جيدًا،|وفضل أن ينتظر الصباح لعرضه على أهل الخبرة.
subtitles.en: The stranger thanked him|and left with his servant under cover of night.|The chief kept the chest without testing its contents|and waited until morning for an expert.

subtitles.ar: في اليوم التالي استدعى أكبر الصاغة في المدينة، وطلب منه تقدير قيمة الجواهر.|فحص الصائغ الأشياء واحدة واحدة،|ثم أخبره أنها ليست ذهبًا ولا فضة،|بل نحاس وقصدير وأحجار من زجاج.
subtitles.en: The next day the chief summoned a master goldsmith.|After examining everything,|the goldsmith declared the metal was brass and tin|and the supposed gems were only glass.

subtitles.ar: اشتد غضب رئيس الشرطة، وأرسل رجاله يبحثون عن الزائر،|فلم يجدوا له أثرًا.|أدرك عندها أن المحتال لم يبع صندوق كنوز،|بل اشترى بثمن رخيص ثقة رجل كان يظن نفسه خبيرًا باللصوص.
subtitles.en: Furious, the chief sent men after the stranger,|but he had vanished.|The supposed reformed robber|had fooled the very official charged with catching thieves.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (guard, executioner)
new_assets.description: Uses only the planned 'guard' preset (AN-086): short tunic to the knee, wide sash, pointed helmet with a neck cloth, optional moustache; pal overrides red and blue.
new_assets.implementation: Add COSTUME.guard in Library/cast/people.js like the servant preset: tunic length 0.55, helmet = half ellipse 46 x 34 with a 14 px spike and a back cloth polygon to the shoulders, all with K brush outlines. Opt-in, so the regression test is unchanged.

new_assets.name: treasureHoard
new_assets.description: The planned chest only (not the whole hoard): 170 x 95 body, domed lid 0..1, ring handles, contents heap with fake 0..1. See props.chest.
new_assets.implementation: One function chest(ctx, x, y, {s, lid, contents, fake, glow, sq}). Body = rounded rect with 2 yellow bands; lid = half ellipse rotated about the back top edge by lid * 1.9 rad (draw lid behind contents when open). Contents = seeded ellipses and rings clipped above the rim; colours through mixHex(gold, dull, fake). Returns {handles, rim, lidTip} anchors for hand targets.

new_assets.name: jewels (with jewelBox)
new_assets.description: Planned cut gems (four colours) for the heap, the two stones held up and the glass shard break; no jewel box needed here.
new_assets.implementation: gem(ctx, x, y, r, col, {glint, fake}): hexagon with a lighter top facet and one white glint; broken state = two polygons separating with fallY.

new_assets.name: goldGlow
new_assets.description: Planned treasure light: tapering yellow rays, halftone disc and staggered star glints, strength 0..1. Its fall from 1 to 0 in three steps is the reveal of S17.
new_assets.implementation: goldGlow(ctx, x, y, r, t, {k}): 9 seeded ray triangles (K.rng) with alpha k, a Ben-Day yellow disc, 5 four-point stars pulsing on different phases. Also tint the nearest face with a yellow multiply rectangle clipped to the head when k > 0.3.

new_assets.name: purse
new_assets.description: Planned fat coin purse with a label option.
new_assets.implementation: Ellipse body, gathered neck, two string ends, coin mark; label via S.label.

new_assets.name: rewardPoster
new_assets.description: Planned WANTED notice with the Library thief face; here it hangs in the chief's own room as the running irony and falls at the end.
new_assets.implementation: Paper rect with a slipped cyan edge; person {kind:'thief'} drawn at s 0.35 clipped to an inner frame; rot and y keyed for the fall (fallY + swing).

new_assets.name: loupe
new_assets.description: New: goldsmith loupe and touchstone (see props.loupe). Reusable for any jeweller, scholar, physician or detective.
new_assets.implementation: Ring + lens + handle; when held at an eye, redraw that eye scaled 1.6 inside the lens clip (call the person eye helper eye2 with the same gaze).

new_assets.name: coinEyes
new_assets.description: Planned greed eyes: pupils replaced by gold coin discs with a glint, pop on with overshoot (64.64, 99.62, 123.1, 146.92).
new_assets.implementation: Opt-in person field coinEyes 0..1 in the eye drawing; off by default.

new_assets.name: flush
new_assets.description: Planned anger flush: red dots climbing the face plus two steam puffs (154.98-157.6).
new_assets.implementation: Opt-in field flush 0..1: red Ben-Day dots clipped to the head circle below a rising line; steam = two cloudFlat puffs at the turban sides.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English is a condensed translation of the Arabic (P2 omits seating the guest and asking his need, P3 omits the chief's amazement, P6 omits the promise to remember the favour, P8 gives a different closing sentence); both are kept verbatim as supplied.
A WANTED poster of a masked robber hangs in the chief's room from the first shot and falls into his lap at the end (not in the script); default: included.

Mask-off moments that let the audience in on the trick before the chief knows (the wink at 43.6, crossed fingers at 94.0, the purse toss and HEE HEE! in the street at 120.2); default: included, kept short.
The treasurer is played as doubtful and tries to warn the chief at 105.1 (the script only says he was ordered to bring the money); default: included.
The highway robbery is shown only as a small comic thought cloud (a purse snatched, STAND AND DELIVER!, no weapon, no injury); default: no weapon.
The chief kicks the chest and hops on a stubbed toe in his rage (157.66), and his turban slips; default: included as light comedy.

English lettering added: KUS, KNOCK!, HEAVY!, SECRET..., I REPENT!, STAND AND DELIVER!, 40,000 DINARS, ONLY 1,000!, PROFIT!, RINGS!, GEMS!, ZZZ, MASTER GOLDSMITH, TINK!, CLINK!, BRASS, TIN, GLASS, GRRR!, GONE!, HEE HEE!; default: all included (cut RINGS!, GEMS!, GRRR! first if it feels crowded).
Transition card text NEXT DAY... (instead of LATER...) because the narration says "the next day"; default: NEXT DAY...
implementation_notes: Room anchors (palaceHall merchant, measured from palaceHallAnchors): floor y 900; door x 60..200 top 580 (cx 130); window x 510..610 y 330..470; lamp (730, 240); curtain x 790..970 top 330. Marks: servant 250, chest 400, sharper stool 540, chief stool 690, treasurer 850, WANTED poster centre (700, 470).

Start from Library/template. Bake palaceHall per option set; only door, curtain, u and lamp are keyed. Draw order in the room: set, poster, servant, chest (when on the floor), sharper, chief, treasurer, goldGlow over the chest, thought clouds, then S primitives, S.finish last.

People: person(ctx, {costume, pal, age, s, x, y:900, sit, seat, kneel, gaze, lid, brow, mouth, talk, handL/handR or handLW/handRW, tip, sq, wet, wink}). Set LIFE.t = t so everyone blinks; give explicit lids on the held looks. Every character always has a gaze target (use look()/gazePlan with head positions about y 900 - 230*s).

Chest path: carried by the servant 13.6-16.9 (chest centre follows the midpoint of his hands, drawn in front of his torso); on the floor at x 400 from 16.95; shoved to x 520 at 79.5-80.2; stays at 520 to the end. Lid: 0 until 56.9, 1 to 66.98, 0.45 to 72.58, 0 until 123.1 (0.3), 0 at 126.3, 1 at 138.5 to the end of S18, open (1) in S20 until it falls shut at 178.05. Contents fake: 0 until 144.42, per-piece from then, whole heap 1 at 154.34.

Mask on / mask off rule for the sharper: his face changes (smirk, wink, brow 0.5) only while the chief's gaze is elsewhere (43.6, 94.0, 111.2) and fully only in the street (120.2). In front of the chief he keeps brow about -0.6 and wet or lowered eyes.

Thought clouds (thoughtCloud, figures at least 110 px on screen): robbery 32.74-37.2 (desertRoad dusk inside), honest shop 86.56-90.2 (marketStall), the chief's sum 97.92-100.8, the escape 167.62-175.2 (desertRoad dusk). Lettering and clouds never cover a face; tags sit above the chest or in the upper third.

Sound (SND master 0.6, only in the listed pauses): chime 4.7, thud 16.95, whoosh 22.2, pop 26.1, chime 43.9, chime 68.2, pop 77.35, pop 90.9, chime 111.5, whoosh 132.5, thud 178.05. KNOCK!, TINK!, CLINK!, GRRR! and HEE HEE! are lettering only (they fall on spoken words).

Camera: {x, y, zoom} keys as in the template camAt; add keys in pairs for holds; the NEXT DAY... card hides the pose and light change at its midpoint (132.5). Panel-only shake for the thud at 16.95, the stamp at 157.04 and the lid at 178.05.
Counters and tags use the style primitives (S.counter, S.label, S.box, S.arrow, S.emphasis). Numbers are written 40,000 and 1,000 (no dashes anywhere in on-screen text).
Subtitles: use the subtitles array for chunks_ar.txt / chunks_en.txt (| marks); the text is verbatim from story/script.json.
warnings: The person figure is front-facing only: carrying the chest, hugging it and kneeling at it must be staged with the chest in front of or beside the figure and world hand targets (handLW/handRW); check with stills that the servant carry reads as heavy (bent knees via sq, lean back via tip, short steps).

The guard preset, chest, jewels, goldGlow, purse, rewardPoster, coinEyes and flush are planned assets that are not in Library yet; if another film has already built them, use those functions and names.
mouth 'smirk' exists on monkey and turtle only; on the person use a smile with one raised brow, or add an opt-in smirk mouth.
S17 packs twelve cues into 13 s on an insert; keep each verdict label on screen until the next one lands and do not move the camera, or it will read as clutter on a phone.
S20 composes cloud, poster and chief in one picture during the pull-out; the cloud must be gone (175.2) before the poster falls (176.0) and THE END must sit clear of the chief's head.
Cue times are word starts from timeline.md and can include a little leading silence; check 56.9 (lid), 105.84 (payment) and 154.34 (GLASS) against the audio by ear.
Coordinator 2026-11-16: capped at the 3-minute limit (end_hold 3.5 -> 2.04 s; 2 times past 180 s pulled to 179.9).
